word: # This book's own vocabulary: names, places and props only this story needs.
# Temporary by design — it lives and dies with the book.

gloss: Xiaoyu — family nickname for Lin Yu
A Ye — "Night", the name she gives the man in her dreams
Xiaomei — her best friend in the city
Old Zhou — a fisherman from her hometown
the Sea Gate — a stone gate in the water between two rocks
